title: Semester and Scholarship
author: Beatrix Winterbourne
blurb: Casper Nystrom, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
